manager_facades.scope: Original PPC manager allocation/release, header clearing and two-byte array release/reset compared for full r3 results, ordered service calls and bounded guest-memory effects, including lazy initialization and callback mutations.
manager_facades.limits: InitializeManager, ResizeArray and RemoveArrayRange reuse previously validated semantic implementations as lower stand-ins. Actual manager vtable methods remain explicit service boundaries; complete ABI and runtime adapters are not established.

object_runtime_adapter.scope: Original PPC full-context and seeded ordinary-memory comparisons through actual strong wrappers: direct and mapping-table calls, disabled and enabled gates, with original fallback counts checked.
object_runtime_adapter.implementation: Shared named ApplyWith algorithms use the existing exact-width volatile PPC_LOAD/PPC_STORE backend. Supported full-width GPR results and ordered memory accesses are retained.

build.runtime: Incremental runtime compile/link passed with the 515 additional wrappers and both new memory-write batches, reusing the supplied PPC archive.
build.semantic_library: The subsequent five manager facades compiled and linked into the semantic library; they have no runtime wrappers and are not covered by this scene run.
build.reused_evidence: Old suites and baseline scene runs were not repeated. No source/image hashes or full PPC regeneration were performed.

scene_smoke.baseline: Earlier observations in runtime_checkpoint.json, runtime_accessor_checkpoint.json and runtime_field_checkpoint.json were reused.

cached_short_memory_pool.note: Only this cached 913-entry candidate pool is covered; it is not the whole-program remainder.
